tool_args.rationale: The open-branch probe established gradient inhibition, but only one gradient has a supply sweep. The finer trajectory batch is the remaining relevant measurement for distinguishing separable attenuation from coupled transfer before fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Separable Hill saturation with gradient attenuation
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It fits the seven observations, but different attenuation curves fit equally well and give different predictions near zero gradient.
The two off-pilot rows change supply and gradient together, so they do not determine whether the gradient changes the shape of the supply response or merely rescales it.
It does not test the supply–gradient interaction.
